_note: The NATIVE half of the type story. The web lane links Type/inter.css (framework-bundled, PLAN.md 6.34); the native lanes register this face via UIAppFonts and resolve `fontFamily="Inter"` through this registry — the family name here matches the web stylesheet's `font-family: InterVariable, Inter, ...` chain by fallback. The face is the framework's own InterVariable-latin.woff2 decompressed LOSSLESSLY to TTF (woff2 is a compression container; iOS loads ttf/otf only — ClosedSource/scripts/font_registry.rb names the rule). OFL; LICENSE travels in Type/vendor/inter upstream. Regenerate: scripts/gen-fonts note in README.
